text:
Ariel: quick idea  small Console card showing per-route lane splits (fast/cost/burst) + simple cost/latency snapshot. useful pre-rollout.
Samir: agree. what are data sources? router emits chosen_model but not lane. need lane_id field or post-hoc mapping.
Noah: adding lane_id to router events is small. telemetry needs schema bump and a canary.
Tess: post-hoc derivation by replaying policy snapshots is possible but laggy. prefer router emit.
Samir: privacy note: for private clouds we should allow masking lane labels. add flag in ingestion.
Ariel: UI: default per-route aggregated; click to expand per-model within lane. show p50, cost/1k, tokens, qps, 12-bucket sparkline (5m buckets).
Noah: materialize aggregates (route,lane) into metrics store to avoid on-demand heavy queries. fallback: sample-based approximate compute.
Tess: simulation: small "what-if" that replays recent samples through new rule; needs exported routing seeds. low-priority follow-up.
ops-bot: deploy plan: router/lane-id/1725560200 -> staging, telemetry/1725560800 -> canary, metrics-job/1725564400 -> roll, console/1725568000 -> feature-flag.
Ariel: Kara (PM) wants a confidence band on cost delta and sample size shown. also hide lanes <0.2% by default.
Samir: will draft event diff and migration note: missing lane_id -> "unknown".
Noah: will add deterministic color hashing for lane_id so UI is consistent.
Tess: good. I'll write the RFC and include privacy masking options.
Ariel: thanks all, will attach mock and follow-ups in the RFC.
